style_notes: sorted descending. Brand primary for bars. No gridlines. Label on bar end.
anti_patterns: vertical bars for >7 items (hard to read labels) | rainbow colours

style_notes: smooth curve. Single colour for single metric. Area fill at 10% opacity for context.
anti_patterns: too many lines (>4 becomes unreadable) | dual Y-axis (confusing)

style_notes: inner radius 60%. Legend below not beside. Brand colours only.
anti_patterns: pie chart (donut is cleaner) | >5 segments (use bar instead) | 3D effects

style_notes: big number (text-4xl). Delta arrow green/red. Subtle card background. Group in 3-4 card row.
anti_patterns: small numbers in tables (lose impact) | mixing too many stats in one card

style_notes: zebra stripes on dark theme. Sticky header. Horizontal scroll on mobile. Sort indicators.
anti_patterns: dense tables without row highlighting | no mobile strategy

style_notes: tiny (40x16px). No axes. Single colour. Used inside table cells or stat cards.
anti_patterns: full-size charts crammed small (unreadable) | sparklines without context number

style_notes: brand primary gradient from light to saturated. Cell labels for values. Legend strip.
anti_patterns: too many colour stops (keep 5-7) | no legend (colours meaningless without scale)
